app_tagline: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [ಕನ್ನಡ] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [ಕನ್ನಡ] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [ಕನ್ನಡ] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [ಕನ್ನಡ] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [ಕನ್ನಡ] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [ಕನ್ನಡ] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [ಕನ್ನಡ] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [ಕನ್ನಡ] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [ಕನ್ನಡ] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [ಕನ್ನಡ] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [ಕನ್ನಡ] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [kn] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [kn] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [kn] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [kn] Type or speak your question for the helper...
